Put each FQ Core ref on its own definition:N row. Every material EI element needs a row with the accepted EI rev-2 id scheme (objects by id; others kind:index: assumption:N, quantifier:N, definition:N, conclusion, solution_concept). Interpreter-added conditions NOT in the CTO-approved source text: mark status 'unmapped' with a note (they become real gaps for gap-ack — honest).
